name: download
description: Local audio or video file of one video URL, through yt-dlp.

verbs.name: get
verbs.description: Download one video URL as audio, the default, or as video with --video. Prints the file path, or the media record with --json. Cached by site, video id, and kind.

url.description: Video page URL on any site yt-dlp supports.

audio.description: Download the best audio-only format. This is the default.

video.description: Download one file with both video and audio.
